chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Hilāl, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Razīn, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever is killed by qisas by the order of the Imam, then there is no diyah for him in the killing nor for any wound.

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, meaning the legitimate authority overseeing legal implementation
key_terms.الْقِصَاصُ: legal retaliation carried out as a prescribed judicial punishment
key_terms.بِأَمْرِ: by the command or order of
key_terms.دِيَةَ: financial compensation due for unlawful killing or injury

ai.seo_question: Is diyah owed if someone is killed in qisas by the order of the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning qisas carried out under the authority of the Imam. When a person is lawfully executed in qisas by the Imam’s order, no diyah is due for his death or for any injury resulting from that execution.
